text:
ivy: deploy-bot paused the auth-service canary. message says chart lock mismatch for oauth-subchart. canary id canary-auth-2026-03. anyone?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] CANARY PAUSED: artifact lock mismatch. requested auth v1.8.0 + oauth v1.4.0, deployed bundle references oauth v1.3.2. Failures: 2/20 pods failed readiness. Action: PAUSE_CANARY. /deploy/logs/1800200000

kevin: looked at the release artifacts: Chart.lock still pins oauth 1.3.2. CI publish likely skipped due to transient S3 timeout. options: manual pin to 1.3.2, re-run publish, or rollback full release.

ivy: prefer re-publish to match git. kevin, can you trigger chart-publisher? ops will need to approve.

kevin: will do. ETA ~8-12m. tagging @ops-admin for repo push.

oncall-sre: recommend temporary pin to avoid churn while publish happens. Use annotation `release.redwood/pin-subchart=oauth-1.3.2`.

ivy: applied pin: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-auth-2026-03 release.redwood/pin-subchart=oauth-1.3.2 --overwrite`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Pin annotation received. Canary will not replace pods for pinned subchart.

ops-admin: approved publish. proceed.

kevin: publish complete. artifact: https://artifacts.internal/charts/auth/1.8.0+sub-oauth-1.4.0.tgz sha256: deadbeef... promoted.

ivy: removing pin and unpausing: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-auth-2026-03 release.redwood/pin-subchart-; kubectl patch canary/canary-auth-2026-03 -p '{"spec":{"paused":false}}' --type=merge`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary resumed. Monitoring 20m. Initial pods healthy.

kevin: filing CI ticket to retry chart publish on transient S3 errors. ticket #2410.

oncall-sre: monitoring metrics for 20m. will escalate on error spike.

ivy: thanks team. adding release-note blurb about oauth subchart bump and provenance link. closing for now.
